description: A wallet's claimable Aave rewards on v3, v4, or both. Covers incentive programmes distributed through Merit as well as the protocol's own, so a GHO or sGHO incentive shows up here rather than anywhere separate. Omit chainId and both versions cover every chain they serve, stating which under 'chainsCovered' and tagging each row with its own chainId. 'chainsNotServed', when present, lists chains this API holds no market on: Aave supports the chain, there is nothing here to read, so an empty result for one of them is not an answer about that chain, and asking again returns the same nothing. On v3 the response also carries the transaction that claims them.

chainId.description: Chain id to restrict to, e.g. 1 for Ethereum. Omit the argument entirely to cover every chain.
